application_credentials.description:
Rhymax Mower signs in to your RoboUP account through Rhymax cloud. Enter the credentials that Rhymax provides for Home Assistant linking:

- **OAuth client ID**: `{client_id}`
- **OAuth client secret**: the client secret from Rhymax

After you sign in, Rhymax cloud returns you to Home Assistant through My Home Assistant (`{redirect_url}`). [Learn more]({more_info_url})

data_description.implementation: The credentials used to sign in to your RoboUP account.

auth.title: Sign in to RoboUP
auth.description: Sign in with your RoboUP account on the page that opens. Once you allow access, you return to Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to RoboUP again
reauth_confirm.description: The link between Home Assistant and your RoboUP account has expired. Sign in again to keep controlling your mowers.

abort.already_configured: This RoboUP account is already linked.
abort.reauth_successful: Your RoboUP account is linked again.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different RoboUP account. Sign in with the account that was linked before.
abort.link_rejected: Rhymax cloud did not accept the Application Credentials. Check that the client ID is `homeassistant` and that the client secret is correct. If both are correct, Home Assistant linking is not available yet.
abort.linking_unavailable: Home Assistant linking is not available yet. Please try again later.
abort.invalid_auth: Rhymax cloud did not accept the sign-in. Please try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Rhymax cloud. Please try again later.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out while preparing the sign-in page.
abort.missing_configuration: Rhymax Mower is not set up correctly. Please follow the documentation.
abort.missing_credentials: Rhymax Mower needs Application Credentials. Please follow the documentation.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. For information about this error, [check the help section]({docs_url}).
abort.oauth_error: Rhymax cloud returned invalid sign-in data.
abort.oauth_failed: Could not complete sign-in with Rhymax cloud. Please try again later.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: No Application Credentials are available right now. Please try again later.
abort.oauth_timeout: Timed out while completing sign-in with Rhymax cloud.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: Rhymax cloud did not accept the sign-in.

auth_failed.message: The link to your RoboUP account has expired. Sign in again to continue.

credentials_missing.message: The Application Credentials of this entry are missing. Sign in again to continue.

relink_required.message: This entry is not linked to a RoboUP account. Delete it and add Rhymax Mower again.

linking_unavailable.message: Home Assistant linking is not available yet. Please try again later.

update_failed.message: Could not get the mower status from Rhymax cloud: {error}

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to Rhymax cloud. Please try again later.

command_failed.message: Rhymax cloud could not send the command. Please try again later.

command_rejected.message: The mower could not carry out the command.

mower_busy.message: The mower is busy with another command. Please try again in a moment.
